shareBasis: Contemporaneous original filing share basis; no future corporate actions applied.
classification: Retrospective point-in-time source-bounded teaching case; not truly blind, not independent clean holdout. Model pretraining may contain subsequent knowledge. No later outcome files or later vintage packets actively consulted before this freeze.
thesis: Value standalone NVIDIA after Mellanox, with semiconductor cyclicality and software/ecosystem durability; do not equate a strong quarter with perpetual acceleration.

sourceAssumptionLedger.fact: FY2021 revenue 16,675; Gaming 7,759 (+41%); Data Center 6,696 (+124%), including Mellanox at 10% of total sales.
sourceAssumptionLedger.inference: Do not extrapolate acquired 124% growth organically. Base FY2022 bridge: gaming +30%, data center +40%, remainder +15% gives about 32.5% consolidated growth.

sourceAssumptionLedger.inference: Base next-year revenue22,094 vs21,200 annualized guidance and32% margin; first quarter is an anchor, not full-year guidance.

sourceAssumptionLedger.fact: Crypto/aftermarket demand and pandemic normalization explicitly flagged; foundry and packaging dependence; inventory commitments2,540.
sourceAssumptionLedger.inference: Bear state has second-year near-stagnation and margin contraction; no free capital recovery.

sourceAssumptionLedger.fact: FY2021 GAAP R&D3,924, SBC1,397, revenue16,675, EBIT4,532.
sourceAssumptionLedger.inference: Keep R&D and SBC in margins; base sales/capital3 is physical/working-capital approximation, not total knowledge-capital ROIC; test2–4.

sourceAssumptionLedger.fact: Federal/state/foreign NOL333/308/344; expiration and utilization restrictions; guided tax10%.
sourceAssumptionLedger.inference: 10% first-year cash-tax proxy fades to21%; do not add NOL tax asset again.

sourceAssumptionLedger.fact: No verified historical Treasury/ERP/beta inputs in provided packet.
sourceAssumptionLedger.inference: WACC9% to8% base, 10.5% to8.5% bear,8.5% to7.5% bull are assumed risk ranges. Mature g2–3% and ROIC10–22% reflect competitive fade, not observed estimates.

base.narrative: Ampere and acquired networking support sustained but decelerating growth; GPU software moat retains above-cost returns, with competition and mix reducing margins toward maturity.

bear.narrative: Pandemic and crypto demand normalize; supplier commitments and competitors compress profitability. Limited release of committed capital.

bull.narrative: Accelerated computing gains broad adoption beyond hyperscalers, preserving software ecosystem rents. No later AI revenue observations used as targets.

uncertainty: States are coherent analyst judgments, not empirically calibrated probabilities or statistical confidence intervals.
WACC is an explicitly assumed USD nominal range, not a retrieved historical risk-free/beta/ERP estimate.
No verified entry market price or total-return outcome used to select assumptions.
Long-run growth, competitive fade and reinvestment are judgments constrained by contemporaneous operations; they are not company guidance.
diagnosticFlags: Retrospective training-data leakage cannot be excluded.
First forecast year approximates next fiscal year; reporting-to-decision stub ignored.
Per-share results conditional on unpriced existing equity awards and book-debt proxy.
Terminal residual may dominate; display terminal share.

accounting.SBC: Future SBC remains fully expensed in GAAP operating margin. Never add back SBC to FCFF. Existing awards are a separate unresolved claim; test a 0–5% equity-value haircut, not assumed fair value. Do not also forecast dilution for the same future compensation.
accounting.R&D: Expensed as reported in base and future margins. No arbitrary R&D asset uplift. Full capitalization would require dated expenditure cohorts, amortization and equal added net reinvestment, preserving cash taxes. This is an explicitly uncapitalized teaching model.
accounting.leases: Lease expense remains an operating cost; lease liabilities excluded from financial debt consistently. No double subtraction.
accounting.taxNOL: Forecast cash-tax proxies transition to 21%; no separate DTA/NOL asset added. Jurisdiction/expiry limitations make aggregate NOL offset invalid.
accounting.reinvestment: Incremental revenue divided by sales-to-capital ratio, excluding R&D already expensed. Negative growth has zero release by default. Procurement commitments flow through future margins/working capital, not wholesale duplicate debt subtraction.
accounting.cash: Subtract 2% of current annual revenue as assumed operating cash via otherClaims; remaining cash/securities added. No independent restriction audit.
accounting.otherClaims: Operating cash only in numeric base bridge; existing equity awards unpriced and acquisition caveats explicit.
accounting.debt: Reported carrying debt is a proxy; no market-value debt reconstruction.

caseSpecific.Arm: Pending $40bn Arm acquisition known at cutoff. This is standalone NVIDIA: excludes future Arm operations, closing cash10bn,44.3m new shares, earnout and employee awards. Paid signing consideration already excluded from cash; no separate contingent refund added. This omission is material and prevents a fully consolidated transaction valuation; do not assume later completion or failure.
caseSpecific.terminal: Base target margin30%, terminalROIC16%, g2.5%; implied stable reinvestment15.625% of NOPAT. Scenario end-year sales and implied scale must be displayed.
